nodes.name: Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes: Receives events from: email trigger, Slack slash commands, n8n cron jobs, or manual API calls. Expects: {type, content, sender, metadata}

nodes.name: Daily Cron Trigger
nodes.notes: Triggers daily tasks: cold-relationship scan, performance brief, pipeline review

nodes.name: Normalise Input
nodes.notes: Standardises input from either trigger into a unified event schema

nodes.name: Run Guardrails
nodes.notes: First layer: PII detection, keyword flags, injection check. Returns risk_level, action_tier, escalation_path.

nodes.name: Critical Veto Check
nodes.notes: If guardrails flagged CRITICAL (harassment, fraud, etc.) — bypass all agents and escalate directly to legal.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({type: $('Normalise Input').item.json.type, content: $('Normalise Input').item.json.content, sender: $('Normalise Input').item.json.sender, metadata: $('Normalise Input').item.json.metadata}) }}

nodes.name: Orchestrator — Route Event
nodes.notes: Orchestrator analyses the event and returns a routing plan: task_type, sub_agents, action_tier, plan steps.

nodes.name: Route to Sub-Agent
nodes.notes: Routes to the correct specialist sub-workflow based on orchestrator's task_type decision

nodes.name: Execute Talent Sub-Workflow
nodes.notes: Calls the Talent Agent sub-workflow (screen, outreach, pipeline)

nodes.name: Execute Scheduling Sub-Workflow
nodes.notes: Calls the Scheduling Agent sub-workflow (meetings, follow-ups, invites)

nodes.name: Execute Onboarding Sub-Workflow
nodes.notes: Calls the Onboarding Agent sub-workflow (plan generation, progress check)

nodes.name: Execute Performance Sub-Workflow
nodes.notes: Calls the Performance Agent sub-workflow (brief, goal risk, nudges)

nodes.name: Execute Knowledge Sub-Workflow
nodes.notes: Calls the Knowledge Agent sub-workflow (policy Q&A, document generation)

nodes.name: Needs Approval?
nodes.notes: If action_tier is needs_approval, route to human approval flow. Otherwise auto-execute and log.

nodes.name: Send Slack Approval Request
nodes.notes: Sends approval request to Slack with Approve/Reject links. Configure SLACK_APPROVAL_CHANNEL in env.

nodes.name: Prepare Audit Log Entry
nodes.notes: Formats the audit log entry. Connect output to a Postgres node to persist.

nodes.name: Write Audit Log
nodes.notes: Persists audit log to Postgres. Connect to your personnel_agent database.

nodes.name: Build Critical Escalation
nodes.notes: Formats the critical escalation message for Legal/CHRO notification

nodes.name: Alert Legal/CHRO
nodes.notes: Alerts the legal channel for critical escalations. Configure SLACK_LEGAL_CHANNEL in env.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({status: 'received', task_id: $('Normalise Input').item.json.metadata.task_id || Date.now().toString(), message: 'Event processed by Personnel Agent'}) }}

nodes.name: Respond to Webhook
nodes.notes: Returns acknowledgement to the webhook caller immediately

meta.description: Autonomous Personnel Agent main orchestrator workflow. Routes any HR/personnel event to specialist sub-agents: Talent, Scheduling, Onboarding, Performance, Knowledge. Includes guardrails, approval routing, audit logging, and critical escalation to legal.
setup_notes: 1. Set environment variables: PERSONNEL_API_URL, PERSONNEL_API_TOKEN, SLACK_APPROVAL_CHANNEL, SLACK_LEGAL_CHANNEL, N8N_BASE_URL
2. Configure Postgres credentials in the Write Audit Log node
3. Create sub-workflows for each agent (Talent, Scheduling, Onboarding, Performance, Knowledge) and set their workflow IDs in env vars
4. Configure Slack credentials in both Slack nodes
5. Activate the workflow and test with a POST to /webhook/personnel-webhook
